data.content: A printable Christmas party games bundle with 8 games for family, friends and office parties: Christmas trivia, holiday word scramble, Would You Rather holiday edition, This or That, Find the Guest bingo, Who Am I cards, carol title fill-in and a scavenger hunt, with answer keys and a party scorecard. 13-page PDF, instant download, print at home.

Six type-in letters from Santa for six kinds of year: nice list, first Christmas, new big sibling, kindness, a hard year done well and a new home. Also a Nice List certificate, Dear Santa wish list, North Pole envelope labels and 12 From Santa gift tags. For parents and grandparents of kids 2 to 9. 13-page PDF, type in free Adobe Reader, no Canva needed. Instant download.
Rhyming Christmas clues little kids can follow and riddles for older kids, so siblings can hunt together. 24 printable clue spots, blank cards and final gift cards. Instant download PDF.

Give your holiday party a moment everyone talks about: guests nominate, vote and crown the winners of 36 lighthearted Christmas awards. Includes host script and certificates. Printable, instant download.

Six pink Christmas Bible verse prints in three frame sizes, ready to print and frame tonight. Coquette bows, stripes and gingham with KJV verses. Printable Christian Christmas wall art, instant download PDF.

A Secret Santa questionnaire with 14 questions covering favorites, sizes, allergies and wish lists, so every gift lands. Part of a printable gift exchange kit with name slips, rules and tags. Instant download, print at home.

Organize your office gift exchange in one evening: organizer page with date, budget and drop-off spot, sign-up sheet, questionnaire and name-draw slips. Printable Secret Santa and white elephant kit, instant download PDF.

Keep the kids busy until the midnight countdown with printable New Year's Eve bingo, a scavenger hunt and Would You Rather cards. Family friendly NYE party games, no drinking games, answer keys included. Instant download PDF.
Tick off every no-spend day in 2027 on printable monthly calendars, then tally the year. Includes no-buy rules, 30-day want list and monthly check-in. Low-buy year planner, instant download PDF.

Hosting Thanksgiving for the first time? This printable planner walks you from three weeks out to dinner on the table: countdown, guest list, menu, turkey size and thaw guide, grocery list and a reverse cooking timeline.

Keep everyone at the table after dinner with 7 printable Thanksgiving games: trivia, bingo, word scramble, This or That, Would You Rather, Gratitude A to Z and a scavenger hunt. For 3 to 30 players. Instant download PDF.

Pink scripture prints for a girls room: pink leopard, hydrangea, gingham and polka dot backgrounds with scalloped frames and KJV verses. Printable Christian wall art in 8x10 and 11x14. Instant download.

Pink Christmas decor with scripture: six matching prints with Luke 2, Isaiah 9:6 and Matthew 2:10 in blush and rose. Frame them for a shelf, gallery wall or girls room. Printable wall art, instant download.

8 printable New Year's Eve games for kids, teens and adults: trivia, word scramble, This or That, Would You Rather, Find the Guest bingo, 2026 in review, 2027 predictions and a scavenger hunt. Family friendly, instant download.

Write your no-buy rules once: what you stop buying, what you still allow and why. Plus a 30-day want list, temptation log and monthly no-spend calendars. Printable 2027 no-buy year planner, instant download.
A calm goal planner for 2027 with all four 12-week rounds dated, weekly plan and check-in pages, a quarter-end reflection and a letter from December 2027. Printable workbook, instant download PDF.

Run a gingerbread house decorating contest night: rules, team sign-up, build plans, judge score cards, People's Choice ballots, tally sheet and award certificates. 15 printable pages, instant download.

Host a Friendsgiving that runs itself: potluck sign-up, host timeline from 2 weeks out, leftover labels and party games. Printable kit for roommates, coworkers and friend groups. Instant download PDF.
7 printable Thanksgiving games for family dinners, Friendsgiving and classrooms in one 11-page pack. Print at home on US Letter or A4 and play the same day. Instant download PDF.

120 original Christmas charades cards in 3 colour-coded levels: 40 for kids, 40 for the whole family and 40 for adults and office parties. Act it out or switch to Draw It mode with the same cards, then keep score on the team score sheet. 14 printable pages plus how-to rules and blank cards to write your own. Print at home on letter paper, cut and play tonight. Instant download PDF.
Put your 2027 goals on paper: year in review prompts, a life areas check-in, dream list, 3 big goals, 12-week breakdown and habit tracker. Printable goal planner for the new year, instant download.
Crown the best gingerbread house with certificates for kids, teen and adult divisions plus People's Choice. Printable gingerbread contest kit with score cards and ballots. Instant download PDF.

7 printable Friendsgiving games for adults: trivia, Would You Rather, Most Likely To, bingo, Find a Friend, leftover scramble and thankful toast cards. Made for a table of 6 to 20 friends. Instant download.

Every plate gets a label with allergen checkboxes so guests know what is in each cookie. Part of a printable Christmas cookie exchange kit with sign-up sheet, recipe cards and best cookie ballots. Instant download.
Host a cozy Christmas whodunit for 8 players: host guide, timeline, 8 character sheets, clue cards in 3 rounds and a sealed solution page. 16 printable pages. Instant download PDF.
